b2_agreement_handling: fixed bilateral protocol result; stop before structural expansion
verification_accounting: one actual PublicVerifier.verify(class_id) call per budget unit; exact V1–V4 checked only for the at-most-16 already-selected classes in that batch; public-pass evidence is built from the audited packed schedule; original state-machine bilateral acceptance is independently checked offline for each distinct agreement
round_definition: one proposal and its response; global across all stages
incremental_pool_turn_recovery: after rejection, next attempt starts with the opposite of the actual last proposer; no acceptable counter returns REJECT, with no private-value disclosure
budget_checkpoints: negotiate at each checkpoint and stage boundary
singleton_order: descending public probe relief adjusted for cost and complexity
pair_order: descending sum of public relief and public normalized-deficit complementarity
random_candidate_permutation: numpy PCG64 seeded by SHA256 of sanitized allowlisted public view; no random instance generation
b2_result_note: B2 agreement is obtained via the same fixed bilateral protocol, not necessarily the previous jointly Nash-optimal B2 representative
